Name: Clean Beach Farm
Author: aaphra
Description:
[center][color=#4e6f8d][u][b][size=6]Clean Beach Farm[/size][/b][/u][/color][size=4]
**I wiill no longer be maintaining this mod! [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20673/]There is an updated version here.[/url]﻿ It includes Ginger Island Beaches and sprinkler compatibility. I will leave up this mod's versions for 1.5 and 1.6, however the 1.6 version cannot farm wet sand tiles.**

Ever get 100+ hours into the perfect Beach Farm setup only to realize your dreams were cut short by some unmovable debris at the bottom? Worry no longer, for this mod will remove the debris blockage and open those tiles up for pathing, gardening, and decorating![/size][size=5][color=#608ea6][b][u]

DETAILS[/u][/b][/color][/size][/center]
Replaces the debris tiles on the southern edge of the map. The new tiles are fully open for pathing, decorating, and farming.

[b]Requirements:
-[/b]SMAPI (3.18.3+)
-Content Patcher (1.29+)
[b]
Compatibility:
[/b]-Will work on existing saves. Be sure to backup your save file just in case!
-Will not be compatible with mods that alter the same tiles of the Beach Farm map.

[b]Installation: [/b]Unzip and place into Stardew Valley/Mods folder.


Credit to ConcernedApe for the map assets.
